parent_protocol.disposition: The completed parent matrix is rejected because exact rank data order differs across arms within every seed. Its checkpoints are retained only as audit artifacts and must not be evaluated.

recovery_basis.acceptance: Both launches produced identical ordered episode/frame hashes for every rank.

source_identity.single_location_requirement: All nine arms train from this exact North source and runtime overlay.

resource_policy.reason: Avoid source-stack drift by using one detached LaWAM commit for every arm.
resource_policy.credential_order: primary first; backup only when the next four-GPU task cannot fit under the primary 20-GPU limit
resource_policy.parallelism: All nine jobs are independent after scheduler-owned North staging.

gates.training_matrix: All nine successful terminal jobs, fixed step-20000 checkpoints, initialization equality within seed, and exact rank data-order equality within seed are required.
gates.evaluation: No TG2R evaluation may start before the new joint matrix integrity gate passes.
gates.tg3: The existing TG2 scientific stop rule remains unchanged.
